title: Representational Atoms in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.14168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. translated_title: 神经网络中的表征原子
translated_abstract: 理解神经网络的内部表征并刻画其与人类概念结构之间的关系，是阐明模型机制的两个关键问题。前者揭示了所学知识如何在内部表征中被组织起来，而后者为借助人类概念结构来解释这些表征提供了基础。在此，我们正式定义了基本表征单元（FRUs），并建立了两个评估标准：保真度与稳定性。我们进一步证明，阈值激活稀疏自编码器（TSAEs）在适当条件下能够以高保真度和高稳定性识别FRUs，并通过大规模实验验证了这一结果。进一步的分析表明，具有更高稳定性的FRUs表现出更强的单语义性，并且能够跨层组合，从而恢复与人类概念结构相对应的语义组织。
tldr: 该论文定义了神经网络中的基本表征单元（FRUs）并建立保真度与稳定性两项评估标准，证明阈值激活稀疏自编码器（TSAEs）在适当条件下可高保真、稳定地识别FRUs，且高稳定性的FRUs具有更强的单语义性并能跨层组合以恢复与人类概念结构相对应的语义组织。
en_tdlr: This paper formally defines fundamental representational units (FRUs) with fidelity and stability criteria, proves that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and shows that more stable FRUs exhibit greater monosemanticity and can compose across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure.
